Alright, I'm the last speaker so let me be clear and direct.

Bob's counter-attack on me is exactly what I'd expect from a Duck cornered in the final speech. Let me break down why his case against me doesn't hold:

First, Bob says I "had time and proximity" to kill Diana and slip to storage. But here's the problem with that: Diana wasn't in medbay when I was there. For me to have killed her, she would have had to arrive in medbay while I was already there — and then I would have killed her and moved to storage. That's possible in theory, but it requires Diana to have walked into medbay during my brief window. Bob's route from cafeteria has equally easy access — cafeteria to medbay is 2 ticks, same as storage to medbay.

Second, and this is the key point: three other players — Eve, Frank, and Charlie — independently arrived at the same read on Bob BEFORE I made my final case. They're not following me; they're seeing the same deflection pattern I saw. Bob narrated his alibi construction out loud ("let me claim that route," "Charlie is isolated... a great scapegoat"), then pivoted to Charlie, and now pivots to me when Charlie's defense held.

Third, Bob's "she HAD to admit it because someone might have seen her" — nobody saw me. I could have claimed cafeteria, storage-only, anywhere. I told the truth because I'm Goose.

Eve and Frank alibi each other. Charlie went away from medbay. I was in medbay before Diana arrived. Bob had identical access with zero witnesses and has now tried to scapegoat two different players in one meeting.

My vote stays Bob.
